description:
Front Garden				

T1	Crab Apple (Malus sylvestris)	Crown reduce by approximately 2m back to most recent previous reduction points. Final height 3m and spread 4m.		

T2	Magnolia	Crown reduce by approximately 2m back to most recent previous reduction points. Final height 4m and spread 4m.

Rear Garden				
T4	Photinia ‘Red Robin' (Photinia × fraseri)	Reduce by 1-2m and re-shape. Final height 3m final spread 2m.		

T5	Cherry (Prunus spp)	Reduce crown by 1-2m to contain. Final height 5m final spread 4m.		

T6	Birch (Betula)	Reduce spires protruding out of top of crown back into crown line, raise crown by 1m. Final height 4m final spread 5m.		

T7	Bay (Laurus nobilis)	Reduce height by 5m and re-shape remaining crown. Final height 5m final spread 3m.		

T8	Plum (Prunus domestica)	Reduce by 1m to contain Final height 2m and final spread 1m.

T10	Holm Oak - Evergreen Oak (Quercus ilex)	Reduce crown by 1-2m and reshape. Final height 4m final spread 2m.		

G11	Yew (Taxus baccata)	Yew Hedge on both sides of garden - Reduce height by 0.5m and trim lightly to contain and shape.		

T12	Common Lime (Tilia x europaea)	Lift branches hanging low in alleyway to 3m, cut back branches resting on shed but maintain screening from houses to rear.		

T13	Cherry (Prunus spp)	Reduce crown by 2-3m. Final height 4m, final spread 3m.		

G14	Privet (Ligustrum spp)	Reduce height of hedge by up to 1m, cut back face to edge of patio. (This will open up the hedge but it should green up within 2 years).		

G15	Bay (Laurus nobilis)	Bay hedge - Reduce height by 2m to the same height as privet, trim back face to contain.		

T16	Common Pear (Pyrus communis)	Dead tree - Fell to ground level.		

T17	Photinia ‘Red Robin' (Photinia × fraseri)	Dead Photinia stump - Grub out.		
T18	Apple (Malus domestica)	Reduce crown by 1m to 1.5m, remove dead limb to rear. Final height 4m Final spread 6m.

T19	Pissard's Plum 'Pissardii' (Prunus cerasifera)	Reduce height by up to 3m, reduce garden side of no.30 only by 3m. Final height 5m and final spread 3m.		

T20	Purple Leafed Plum (Prunus cerasifera 'Pissardii')	Reduce crown by up to 3m, cut back from building to give 2m clearance. Final height 4m and final spread 3m.
